gloss: the five court musicians of a hina doll display

definitions.gloss: the five court musicians of a hina doll display
definitions.explanation: The set of five boy musicians placed on the third tier of a {雛人形|ひなにんぎょう} display for the Doll Festival. From left to right they play the {太鼓|たいこ} (drum), {大鼓|おおつづみ} (large hand drum), {小鼓|こつづみ} (small hand drum), and {笛|ふえ} (flute), with the fifth serving as the singer.

examples.japanese: {三段目|さんだんめ}に{五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: We arrange the five court musicians on the third tier.

examples.japanese: {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}はみんな{子供|こども}の{姿|すがた}をしている。
examples.english: The five court musicians are all depicted as children.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{毎年|まいとし}、{内裏雛|だいりびな}から{五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}まで{丁寧|ていねい}に{飾|かざ}っていた。
examples.english: Every year my grandmother carefully set out everything from the imperial dolls down to the five court musicians.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}を{飾|かざ}る: to display the five musicians
- {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}の{段|だん}: the tier of the five musicians
- {笛|ふえ}や{太鼓|たいこ}を{持|も}った{五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし}: the five musicians holding flute and drums

CULTURAL NOTE:
A full {雛人形|ひなにんぎょう} display is tiered: the {内裏雛|だいりびな} (imperial couple) on top, {三人官女|さんにんかんじょ} (three court ladies) below them, and the {五人|ごにん}{囃子|ばやし} on the third tier. Because the set is so familiar, the phrase is sometimes used playfully for any group of five performers.
